title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were chosen from the cited sources: CNET (source 1), Consumer Reports (source 2), Frontiers (source 4), and PCMag (source 0). Products mentioned by multiple sources were ranked higher.
assumptions: No price information was included because the sources only gave a price for the Saros Z70; other products had no listed price.

verdict.pick: Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum and Mop with OmniGrip Mechanical Arm
verdict.line: Buy this if you want a home robot that can vacuum, mop and physically move small items. It’s praised by both CNET and Consumer Reports for its unique arm, though it costs a premium.
